'''Uulshos Manufacturing''' was the manufacturer of many [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles as well as [[Yacht/Legends|space yachts]], but are best known for the [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] and [[Storm Skimmer Patrol Sled]]. They also produced the [[Uulshos justice droid]].

==Description==
Uulshos Manufacturing was a manufacturing company specializing in producing vehicles for the military and civilian markets. The company had a reputation for releasing cheap, unexceptional designs that were affordable and in common use by defense forces and [[Militia/Legends|militias]] on backwater [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Uulshos also manufactured a line of [[Transport/Legends|transports]] that could be configured for different uses, including cargo hauling, [[Scout/Legends|scouting]], or as [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]]. Among Uulshos Manufacturing's most well-known products was the [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and the [[Storm Skimmer Patrol Sled]].<ref name="EGVV" />

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]] of the [[Company/Legends|company]] turned against the crew of a valuable [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] due to the manipulations of a republic saboteur.<ref name="Mission" />
